# Carpenterwala - Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Services Overview

## 1. About Carpenterwala
Carpenterwala is Bangalore's premier verified home improvement and handyman marketplace connecting homeowners directly with background-checked carpenters, painters, plumbers, and electricians at 0% platform commission. All service providers undergo police background checks, Aadhaar identity verification, and trade skill assessments.

- Website: https://carpenterwala.com
- Operations Hub: Thanisandra Main Road, Bangalore, Karnataka 560077, India (Doorstep service across Bangalore)
- Phone: +91-809-555-1001
- Email: contact@carpenterwala.com
- Operating Hours: Monday – Sunday, 08:00 AM – 09:00 PM IST

## 2. Interactive Calculation Engines
### Water Wastage & Tap Drip Cost Calculator
- Location: https://carpenterwala.com/services/plumbing#calculator
- Purpose: Quantifies municipal and tanker water wastage in Indian homes resulting from slow dripping taps, leaking flush valves, or pipe pinholes.
- Methodology: Converts drip frequency (e.g., 10 to 120 drops per minute) into daily and monthly litres lost and financial impact based on Bangalore municipal vs tanker water pricing.

### Electricity Appliance Consumption & Wastage Calculator
- Location: https://carpenterwala.com/services/electrical#calculator
- Purpose: Calculates power consumption (kWh / units) and monthly electricity bill increases caused by faulty wiring, inefficient appliances (fans, ACs, geysers, refrigerators), and vampire standby draw.
- Methodology: Maps appliance wattage and operational hours against standard BESCOM electricity tariff slabs.

### Wall Painting Area & Paint Quantity Estimator
- Location: https://carpenterwala.com/services/painting#calculator
- Purpose: Computes exact wall surface area, primer requirements, paint litres needed (1 coat vs 2 coats), and total material + labor budget for 1 BHK, 2 BHK, and 3 BHK residential apartments.

## 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) & AI Agent Integration
Carpenterwala implements the Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) and OpenAPI 3.1 specification for autonomous AI agent discovery and tool execution across Google Gemini (Android Mobile), Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, and Perplexity AI.

### Protocol Endpoints
- Remote WebMCP Server (JSON-RPC 2.0 / SSE): `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp`
- OpenAPI 3.1 Spec for Gemini & Custom GPT Actions: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/openapi.json`
- REST Tool Route: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/tools/{toolName}`

### JSON-RPC 2.0 Discovery Methods
- `initialize`: Returns protocol version (`2024-11-05`), server name (`carpenterwala-mcp-server`), and tool capabilities.
- `tools/list`: Lists all available tools and parameter JSON Schemas.
- `tools/call`: Executes a tool with provided arguments and returns standard MCP text content.

### Tool Registry & Purpose
1. `initiate_technician_onboarding`:
   - Pre-registers service technicians (carpenters, painters, plumbers, electricians).
   - Generates an encrypted, stateless 1-click mobile verification link (`https://carpenterwala.com/pro/login?session={token}`).
   - **Zero-Trust Security Flow**: Technicians verify mobile OTP and upload Government ID (Aadhaar / Driving License / Selfie) inside the secure browser session. No raw OTPs or unmasked Aadhaar documents are ever ingested by 3rd-party LLM chat transcripts.
   - **Abuse Prevention**: Strict rate-limit capped at 3 onboarding attempts per 24 hours per phone number and IP address.
2. `check_technician_application_status`:
   - Checks onboarding verification, active pro badges, or pending review steps by 10-digit mobile number.
3. `search_verified_pros`:
   - Queries background-checked verified pros in Bangalore filtered by trade and locality.
4. `get_service_rate_card`:
   - Returns official Bangalore standard labor rates in INR (₹) at 0% platform commission.
5. `calculate_service_estimate`:
   - Computes wall painting square footage, tap drip water wastage (litres/₹), or appliance power consumption.
6. `request_service_callback`:
   - Logs customer service inquiries and dispatches direct leads to local handymen with 60-90 min response time.
